full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white architectural photograph shows an empty concrete walkway curving between massive smooth walls beneath an overhead circular opening. The scene is viewed from near eye level at the start of the passage. On the left, a tall curved wall sweeps from the lower foreground toward two narrow dark doorways in the distance. Its surface is pale gray with visible formwork seams, tiny pinholes, and occasional dark marks. A thin dark channel runs along the base, separating wall from walkway. On the right, a heavy cylindrical volume projects into the passage, its rounded underside hovering above a deep black recess. The right foreground wall is close to the camera and bears the same cast-concrete texture. Above, the roof curves around a large irregular oval of pure white sky, opening light onto the pathway. The pavement consists of broad light slabs with fine joints and faint shadow gradients; it bends to the left around the central mass and disappears into the narrow distance. No people, plants, signs, or movable objects occupy the scene. Soft daylight from the overhead opening strikes the inner left wall and central floor, while the undercut on the right remains very dark. The shadows are broad and precise enough to clarify the scale and volume, but they have no sharp sunlit edge. The camera keeps the vertical lines steady, letting the arcs and sweeping floor route create movement. Fine grain and concrete pores add tactile detail to otherwise spare planes. The overall composition is quiet and monumental, using the contrast of light open sky, immense gray curves, and one black void to make the empty circulation space feel sculptural.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白建筑照片呈现空无一人的混凝土步道，在巨大光滑墙面间弯曲，头顶有一道环状开口。场景从通道起点附近的平视高度观看。左边，一道高弧墙从下方前景扫向远处两处狭窄深门洞。表面呈浅灰，带可见模板接缝、细小孔洞和零星深痕。底部有一条细暗沟，把墙与步道分开。右边，沉重圆柱体量伸入通道，圆转底面悬在深黑凹处上方。右前墙靠近相机，带相同浇筑混凝土纹理。上方，屋顶绕住一大片不规则椭圆形纯白天空，让光落到路径上。地面由宽阔浅色板块构成，接缝细，阴影渐层微弱；它绕中央体量向左弯，消失在狭窄远处。没有人物、植物、标识或可移动物件。柔和日光从顶上开口进入，照亮内侧左墙与中央地面，右边悬挑下方保持极深。阴影宽阔且足以说明尺度和体积，但没有强烈日照的锐边。相机保持竖线稳定，让弧线和扫动地面路线产生运动感。细颗粒和混凝土孔洞给其他部分简洁的平面添入可触细节。整体构图安静而宏伟，以开放的亮天、巨大灰弧和一处黑洞的对比使空荡交通空间显得雕塑化。
style_prompt_en: The monochrome architectural photography treats mass, void, and curve as the principal visual elements. Smooth cast surfaces retain pinholes, seams, and faint stains, so large gray planes remain materially believable. An overhead white opening pours diffuse light into a controlled path, while deep recesses create strong black counterweights. Repeated joints and edges follow the form's sweep and lead the eye around a central volume. Wide negative space and the absence of clutter make subtle tonal gradients important. The camera keeps geometry stable at human eye level, allowing the building's own curvature to supply movement. Light and shadow define real three-dimensional undercuts rather than flattening everything into graphic bands. The overall effect is austere and contemplative, with tactile concrete and spacious composition giving quiet monumentality.
style_prompt_zh: 这种单色建筑摄影把体量、空处与弧线当作主要视觉元素。光滑浇筑表面仍有孔洞、接缝和淡污，让大灰面在材料上可信。顶上的白色开口把漫射光引入受控通路，深凹处形成有力黑色配重。重复接缝与边缘追随形体弯扫，引导视线绕过中央体积。宽裕留白和无杂物使细微明度渐层变得重要。相机在人眼高度保持几何稳定，让建筑自身曲率提供动势。光影界定真实三维悬挑凹部，而非把所有东西压成图形带。整体效果严峻而沉思，可触混凝土与宽敞构图带来安静的纪念碑感。
theme_en: A curving concrete walkway beneath a sweeping roof in monochrome light
theme_zh: 单色光影中一条混凝土步道弯过大幅弧形屋顶下
name: Tadao Ando
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
